newsitem.title: EGYPT: Faisal Islamic Bank Q3 profits higher.
newsitem.headline: Faisal Islamic Bank Q3 profits higher.

text.p: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt increased profits for the third quarter of the Islamic year 1417 to 262 million pounds ($77.2 million) from 213 million for the same period in the previous year, the bank said on Monday.
The bank said its third quarter ended on February 8, 1997 and on February 16, 1996 for the previous year.
Of this profit, the bank said it would distribute 221 million to its depositors compared to 204.5 million in Q3 of the 1416 Islamic year.
Total assets also rose to 6.876 billion pounds from 6.469 billion. Deposits were also higher at 5.119 billion from 4.988 billion in same period of Islamic year 1416.
The bank does not pay interest, which many Islamic scholars consider to be usury which is forbidden in Islam. Its shares are listed on the Egyptian stock exchange in Egyptian pounds and U.S. dollars.
A bank executive last month said that Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt will raise its capital by a maximum of $50 million, a 50 percent increase that could let foreign shareholders own a majority stake.
